description: Revert to the most stable high-performing configuration (Depth=8, Matrix LR=0.06, WD=0.1) which consistently yielded ~0.9905 val_bpb, as the previous attempt to stabilize with lower LR (0.055) and higher WD (0.12) resulted in a slightly worse 0.9902, suggesting the model needs slightly more aggressive updates to converge fully within the 5-minute budget.
